display.purpose: Landing headline only; the largest voice on any surface.

body.purpose: Prose, rationale, and findings; max line length ~65ch.

label.purpose: Field labels, tags, table headers, and every measurement.

motion.name: decode
motion.purpose: Signature moment: parsed fields and list rows reveal with a short stagger. 0.5s, staggered 55-70ms. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Page transition: each route fades and lifts 10px on mount. 0.45s.

motion.name: grow
motion.purpose: Meters grow from the origin when they mount, then track value changes via transform. 0.8s.

motion.name: count-up
motion.purpose: Score numerals count up over 0.75s on mount. Reduced-motion jumps straight to the value.

motion.name: shimmer
motion.purpose: Colored loading skeleton sweep while an analysis runs. 1.4s.

motion.name: pulse-border
motion.purpose: Dropzone border pulses to the mark while a file is dragged over it. 0.9s.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action, e.g. 'Analyze my resume' or 'Run the review'.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-mark, #c9f24a); color: var(--color-mark-ink, #10130a); border: 1px solid var(--color-mark, #c9f24a); border-radius: 2px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.15s ease, outline-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #0e1113); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions such as Print or Open; boundary darkens on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #0e1113); border: 1px solid var(--color-rule-strong, #a9b0a8); border-radius: 2px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink, #0e1113); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #0e1113); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Bracketed-feeling mono label for state, skills, and keyword gaps.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--color-rule-strong, #a9b0a8); border-radius: 2px; padding: 2px 6px; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-ink-soft, #3c4247); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.66rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Square-ish field with a monospace value and an uppercase mono label above.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; color: var(--color-muted, #6b7176); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.66rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); color: var(--color-ink, #0e1113); border: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #d3d7d1); border-radius: 2px; padding: 10px 12px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-ink, #0e1113); }

components.name: Panel (Sheet)
components.description: The structural container: a bordered sheet with a ruled header, never a floating card.
components.html:
SCORED DIMENSIONS
Content sits on ruled rows.
components.css: .ds-panel { border: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #d3d7d1); border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-surface, #fff); } .ds-panel-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #d3d7d1); color: var(--color-ink-soft, #3c4247); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.66rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-panel-body { padding: 16px; color: var(--color-ink-soft, #3c4247); font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Parse Row
components.description: Signature: LABEL — dotted rule — VALUE, the literal shape of a machine extracting fields.
components.html: QUANTIFIED RESULTS0 found
components.css: .ds-parse-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #d3d7d1); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-parse-label { color: var(--color-ink-soft, #3c4247); } .ds-parse-rule { flex: 1; height: 1px; background: var(--color-rule, #d3d7d1); } .ds-parse-value { color: var(--color-fail, #cf3218); }

narrative.overview:
Resume Analyzer looks like the machine's own readout. An applicant tracking system does not read a resume the way a person does — it flattens it into fields — and this interface adopts exactly that flat, ruled, measured view rather than dressing it up as a friendly dashboard. The product's whole claim is a calibrated, honest screen, so the surface is a working sheet: hairline rules, fixed columns, monospace field labels, tabular numerals, and square corners. Density is the point, not a cost.

The palette is cool and instrumental. A near-black ink sits on a cool off-white ground, and a single highlighter-lime mark is the only committed accent — used for marked emphasis and the primary action, always carrying black text. Nothing is decorated to look impressive; every rule, tick, and meter is doing measurement work. Depth is expressed with hairlines and a single filled field tone, never with shadow or gloss.

The tone is technical but not cold-by-default: generous vertical rhythm, plain-language verdicts, and a fix queue that reads as instructions rather than a scoreboard. The one authored moment is a short decode reveal when parsed fields appear, echoing a machine resolving text into rows.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled sheets with hairline separators instead of floating rounded cards.
Monospace for every field label, tag, and measurement; Archivo for headings and running text.
One highlighter accent on black; state colors (pass/warn/fail) reserved for meaning.
Linear ticked meters and large tabular numerals, never progress rings.
Flat by construction: no shadows, no gradients, no pill shapes.

rules.name: The One Mark Rule
rules.body: The highlighter accent is the only chromatic accent in the system. It covers a small fraction of any screen and carries black text without exception; it never becomes a large colored field.

rules.name: The State-Color Rule
rules.body: Pass, warn, and fail are semantic only. They are never used for decoration, brand, or emphasis, and their soft tints appear only as notification grounds.

rules.name: The Label Rule
rules.body: Anything monospace and uppercase is a label or a measurement. Prose never sets in monospace, and labels never set in Archivo.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that can be compared vertically (scores, dates) uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow anywhere, including hover and focus. State is shown with border color, border weight, and fill — never with elevation.

dos: Do separate content with 1px Rule hairlines and full-width rows.
Do set every label, tag, and measurement in monospace uppercase with tabular figures.
Do reserve the highlighter mark for the primary action and marked emphasis, always with black text.
Do keep corners at 0px for sheets and 2px for controls.
Do express state with border and fill, and keep the surface flat.
donts: Don't use box-shadow or any elevation to imply depth.
Don't use rounded pills, capsules, or large radii.
Don't use gradients, glass, or blur as decoration.
Don't use the highlighter mark as body text or as a large background field.
Don't use pass/warn/fail colors for anything but state, and never as a left/right border accent.
Don't set running prose in monospace or labels in Archivo.
Don't ship a card grid of icon + heading + text as page structure.
